title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an object_extension item's refusals fit the item door, and its target is the key the object is registered under (#28834)
body:
Fixes #28834 _Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XT6ZDDQFYhmZ6kxDp4hSdwM)_ Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs` quotes either override refusal sentence or teaches an extension's `extend` spelling against a legacy `ns__name` key; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` teaches `objectExtensions` by a plain object name, which stays admitted. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：① 给 `object_extension` 带 `overrides` 时的拒绝句改成「扩展不接受覆盖，名字就是它扩展的对象，请直接改这个扩展」，不再叫人「换个新名字另建」；给 `object` 带 `overrides` 的拒绝句在 manifest 的 `objectExtensions` 之外，也点出 `/api/v1/meta/object_extension` 这个保存口。② 保存/发布/回滚口拒绝 `extend` 写成短名、但注册表实际挂在旧式 `ns__name` 键上的扩展（以前会再开一个同短名的幽灵对象），拒绝句写出两种拼法。 - **为什么改**：PR #28811 合约评审的 should-fix 1、4（卡 #28834）。第 3 项（spec 注册行注释）在 `packages/spec/**`，按裁决留给 spec 席位，本 PR 不碰。 - **风险与回滚**：拒绝码和状态不变（`NOT_OVERRIDABLE`/403、`VALIDATION_ERROR`/400）；其他类型的拒绝句逐字不变（permission 对照钉住）。收窄只命中带 `__` 的旧键，实测本仓库与 hotcrm 的 manifest 和对象都没有。回滚 = revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts` 的 `judgeOverrideWrite` 两处句子；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` 第 4 步新加的拼法判断。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-object-extension-item-door-fit.test.ts`，预期 5 个测试全绿。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位安排合约评审并落地。 ## What changes - **`declared_type_not_overridable` for `object_extension`** (`judgeOverrideWrite`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`). A new branch ahead of the D6 sentence, for this type only. The new sentence: `` 'object_extension/NAME' carries `overrides`, but an object extension takes no override (ADR-0146 D10): it adds to the object it extends and is stored under that object's name. Remove `overrides` and edit the object_extension 'NAME' itself. `` The rule name, code and status stay. - **`declared_object`** names both places an extension is written: `` ... add the change as an object extension in the base's paired .custom package: an `object_extension` item saved through `/api/v1/meta/object_extension`, or an `objectExtensions` entry of its manifest. `` The rule, code and status stay. This sentence is also what `os validate` and the install door print, so it names the manifest entry as well as the item door. - **The target spelling** (`objectExtensionItemRefusal` step 4, `protocol-object-extension-item.ts`). After `getObject(extend)` resolves, the gate refuses with `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 on `extend` when the resolved object's `name` (the key it is registered under, since `computeFQN` is the identity) differs from `extend`. The sentence names both spellings and says to save it under the registered key. The gate is the same one that save, per-item publish and history restore already call. ⛔ The manifest loop in `objectql/src/engine.ts` and `computeFQN` are untouched. - `.changeset/28834-object-extension-door-fit.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker and the BREAKING banner. - No new rule, no new `OverrideWriteRule` member, no new error code, no new gate, nothing under `packages/spec/**`. ## Measurement before the narrowing (Wanted 3) - **Shipped manifests.** The non-test `objectExtensions` in this repository are `plugin-auth` (`extend: 'sys_sso_provider'`) and the showcase (`extend: 'showcase_account'`). Each resolves to the same key, so neither is refused. `hotcrm` has no `objectExtensions` and no `extend:`. - **Legacy keys.** No non-test object in this repository or in `hotcrm` is named `ns__name`. The only `extend` with `__` in the tree is a spec/lint test fixture (`cbpx__cbpx_line`), which names the key itself and so is admitted. - **Stored rows.** I have no deployed store to read. The item door these rows come through landed in #28574 (`0c1829a28a`), the change just before this one. The boot and read hydrations register stored rows through `registrableObjectExtension` and never call this gate, so a stored row with that spelling is not refused at rest. Only a re-save of it is. No live row was found that this would refuse, so the order's stop condition did not trigger. ## Tests `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item-door-fit.test.ts` (new, 5 tests). It uses the rig of `meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`: a real better-sqlite3 `SqlDriver`, a real `ObjectQL` engine and the real protocol. The base `com.acme.crm` is registered through `registerApp`, owns `crm_account` and the legacy-keyed `crm__case`, and its pair is installed through `installPackage`. Every refusal asserts its envelope, its whole sentence and that no row was left. | Reading | Result | |---|---| | Head `461552ac` | `Tests 5 passed (5)`; with the #28574 file, 24/24 | | Base `0c1829a2` (both production files restored, the test kept, metadata-protocol rebuilt without the turbo cache) | `Tests 3 failed, 2 passed (5)`. Red: the extension sentence (base said `a object_extension takes no override (ADR-0146 D6) ... create your own object_extension under a new name`), the object sentence (no item door), the folded spelling (admitted, `null`). Green: the permission control and the registered-key control. | The tests: - the object_extension sentence, exactly, and not "new name" / "new similar"; - the object sentence, exactly; - control: `permission`'s D6 sentence, byte for byte; - the folded short name `case` refused in draft and in publish mode, with the issue on `extend`, no row left, and no contributor under `case`; - control: `crm__case` admitted and published, the pair as its `extend` contributor, `region__c` on the object.
Ablations (node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs from committed HEAD, metadata-protocol rebuilt without the cache, marker counted in dist) - **The extension sentence branch.** `if (type === OBJECT_EXTENSION_TYPE) {` guarded off (marker `ABL_A`, 1 in dist). `Tests 1 failed, 4 passed`: exactly the extension sentence. Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. - **The item door in the object sentence.** `${OBJECT_EXTENSION_ITEM_DOOR}, or` replaced (marker `ABL_B`). `Tests 1 failed, 4 passed`: exactly the object sentence. Restored clean. The first attempt dropped the constant entirely, so the DTS build refused an unused local (exit 9, nothing measured). It was re-run with the constant kept as `.slice(0, 0)`. - **The spelling check.** Its condition guarded off (marker `ABL_C`). `Tests 1 failed, 4 passed`: exactly the folded-spelling test. Restored clean. - After the last leg, metadata-protocol was rebuilt at HEAD: 0 markers in dist, and the card files are 24/24.
Suites, typecheck, lint and gates at head | Run | Result | |---|---| | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` | 297 files passed, 4 skipped · 22090 tests passed, 26 skipped | | `@objectstack/objectql` | 522 files · 10009 tests | | `@objectstack/runtime` | 514 files · 9261 tests passed, 19 skipped | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` | exit 0 | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) | exit 0. The first run was exit 1 on `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts` TS2307 because `@objectstack/driver-turso` had no `dist/` in the fresh worktree; after building it, exit 0 with the ledger unchanged. | | `eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed TS files | exit 0 | | `check:type-check-debt` | exit 0 | | `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (61 families) | all 61 exit 0 after a full `pnpm build`; `--ran`: 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The changeset and citation families were re-run after the last amend: exit 0. No gate added. | | Full dogfood (narrowing arm), head `461552ac` | VERDICT command-exit 1 · Test Files 4 failed, 376 passed, 3 skipped (383) · Tests 4 failed, 3115 passed, 28 skipped (3147). The four reds are the 18.0-upgrade files `audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies`, `identity-mail-read-gate` and `upgrade-18x-harness` (`no such table: sys_activity__r20261019`, rewrite counts halved). The same four files on base `0c1829a2`, with metadata-protocol rebuilt at base: the same 4 red, 45 passed. So they are on main, tracked by #28849, and not this diff. |
## Acceptance notes - **Wanted 2 is not here.** The `object_extension` registry row's comment is in `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`, which the ruling sends to the spec seat. It is untouched and left for that seat. The PR #28811 body's probe line `objects: []` (the export omits the key) is on a merged PR, so it is noted here rather than edited. - **Why `name` is the resolved key.** `registerObject` files an object under `computeFQN(namespace, schema.name)`, which is the identity, so the merged object's `name` is its key. A target named by its own key, legacy or not, is unchanged. - **Branch order.** The extension branch comes after the D10 `object` branch and before the D6 disposition check. `object_extension` is classified `excluded`, so before this change it reached the D6 sentence. ## Verification `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-object-extension-item-door-fit.test.ts` gives 5/5. The same command on base `0c1829a2`, with metadata-protocol rebuilt, gives 3 red, as in the table. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01FEkQ5kkSYvKhs52WGfTj3c
